description:
Port-map §7. Long-lived JSON-line server over stdin/stdout.

Modules:
- OctoPi.Coder.Modes.Rpc — main server GenServer
- OctoPi.Coder.Modes.Rpc.JsonL — line reader from :stdio
- OctoPi.Coder.Modes.Rpc.Protocol — request/response encoding

Request shape (JSON per line):
  {"id": "req-1", "method": "prompt", "params": {...}}

Response shape:
  {"id": "req-1", "result": ...}       // or
  {"id": "req-1", "error": {...}}

Events (no id):
  {"type": "event", "event": "turn_start", "data": {...}}

Methods at minimum: prompt, continue, steer, follow_up, abort,
wait_for_idle. Events: every Agent.Event.* forwarded as JSON.

Port map flags JSON serialization of complex AI structs as a
concrete concern — probably needs a protocol/to_json helper per
event.

TDD:
- Write a JSONL line to stdin, assert response line on stdout
- Event streaming: prompt → assert JSON event lines arrive in
  order
- Malformed JSON → error response with id: null
- Abort via RPC → session stops

Depends on .2, .4, .5, .6.
title: RPC mode: JSONL stdin/stdout protocol
